_doc: Params of WCET-E (pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/app/wcet_e.c, rttools.ucxgen --bodies) for rttools.wcet, with ucx-os.json and ucxgen.json; the loops of the bodies carry WCET_LOOP_BOUND and WCET_LOOP_TOTAL in the source. tcb = 5 (PE 0-0: F, D, B, A and the idle task). heap_blocks: blocks of the heap of the largest PE: 1 end block, 3 per task and for the idle task (tcb, rt, stack; kernel/ucx.c), 2 per comm (queue and slots; lib/queue.c), 1 per output packet (create_pkt) and 2 packets in flight per input edge between PEs (rttools.ucxgen memory, --in-flight): 29 on PE 0-0, bound 32.
